document_title: POLARIS Forecast Uncertainty -> Risk -> EMS Interface Design
branch: NEW RESEARCH BRANCH: FORECAST UNCERTAINTY -> RISK -> EMS INTERFACE DESIGN

current_bottleneck.core_problem: Conflation of pointwise forecast uncertainty, physical energy reserve, and critical load protection.
current_bottleneck.point_forecast_failure: Candidate F point forecast lower MAE/RMSE failed to reduce closed-loop diesel consumption; over-prediction bias during cloudy periods depleted battery storage, causing 983.3 kWh of critical unmet load.
current_bottleneck.static_q10_failure: Static q10 slashes unmet load by 93.4% but forces +38.2% diesel fuel increase and +92.9% solar curtailment by assuming all 24 hours simultaneously breach the 10th percentile.
current_bottleneck.ebr_failure: Governed 6-hour EBR reserve (38.6 kWh, 57.83% SOC) is unconditional on incoming solar; because it sits at J2 (Priority 3) above J3 fuel (Priority 2), GAP19 burns diesel at step 0 to satisfy the reserve, resulting in +20.5% fuel penalty in Causal NWP.
current_bottleneck.ebr_off_failure: Removing EBR entirely cuts fuel by 68.4% but causes critical unmet load to surge +16.9%, failing reliability gates in 101 of 123 origins.
current_bottleneck.stochastic_milp_failure: Multi-scenario MILP introduces lexicographic priority inversions in HiGHS (J4 curtailment chasing depleted battery storage prematurely on Origin 77, causing SOC floor breach to 19.61%).

candidate_interfaces.name: Static Quantile (q10)
candidate_interfaces.description: Replace point forecast with static empirical lower quantile (q10).
candidate_interfaces.flaw: Ignores AR(1) temporal correlation and microgrid state; causes chronic diesel over-dispatch and excessive curtailment.

candidate_interfaces.name: Fixed Reserve (EBR 6h)
candidate_interfaces.description: Unconditional 6-hour critical load survivability reserve in battery storage.
candidate_interfaces.flaw: Unconditional on renewable forecast; forces step-0 diesel generation even before clear-sky solar peaks.

candidate_interfaces.name: Cumulative Shortfall Risk
candidate_interfaces.description: Convert forecast errors into cumulative shortfall distribution via AR(1) and clear-sky scaling.
candidate_interfaces.flaw: Focuses only on solar error distribution; ignores battery state-of-charge headroom and diesel capacity.

candidate_interfaces.name: Chance-Constrained / Probabilistic Dynamic Reserve
candidate_interfaces.description: State-dependent dynamic reserve trajectory bounding probability of critical deficit over all horizons.
candidate_interfaces.merit: Scales reserve with forecast uncertainty and critical demand while discounting existing battery energy and scheduled generation; drop-in compatible with GAP19.

candidate_interfaces.name: Scenario-Based Multi-MILP
candidate_interfaces.description: Sample discrete solar trajectories and solve stochastic MILP with non-anticipativity.
candidate_interfaces.flaw: Excessive computational overhead (up to 74s solve time) and HiGHS priority inversion artifacts.

candidate_interfaces.name: Economic Risk Pricing Interface
candidate_interfaces.description: Replace hard reserve constraint with expected cost of critical deficit in objective function.
candidate_interfaces.flaw: Compromises strict lexicographic priority of critical load protection; vulnerable to numerical scaling tradeoffs.

mathematical_formulation_summary.error_process: AR(1) with conditional regime bias: e_{t+k} = mu(x_{t+k}) * (1 - phi^k) + phi^k * e_t^{obs} + epsilon_{t+k}
mathematical_formulation_summary.cumulative_variance: sigma_{C, k}^2 = sum_{j=1}^k [ sum_{l=j}^k phi^{l-j} ]^2 * sigma_{innov}^2(x_{t+j})
mathematical_formulation_summary.shortfall_quantile: Q_{1-epsilon}(C_k) = sum_{j=1}^k e_{hat, j} + q_{cal}(1-epsilon) * sigma_{C, k}
mathematical_formulation_summary.solar_risk_energy_wh: Delta E_{sol, k}^{risk} = K_{pv} * Delta t * max(0, Q_{1-epsilon}(C_k))
mathematical_formulation_summary.dynamic_reserve_trajectory: R_k^{dyn}(t) = max( R_{base}^{surv}, Delta E_{sol, k}^{risk} + sum_{j=1}^k [ P_{crit, j} / eta_{dis} - P_{pv, j}^{point} - P_{wind, j}^{point} ] * Delta t )

required_inputs: Forecast cloud cover (causal MEPS NWP 18Z trajectory)
Candidate F / Stage 8.1 point forecast vector
Current station battery energy and SOC (SCADA telemetry)
AR(1) parameters (phi, mu, alpha_0, alpha_1 fit on 2020-2021)

gap19_insertion_point.layer: Layer C: Stage 2 Unified Reserve Envelope (Constraints 288-311)
gap19_insertion_point.integration_mechanism: Pass 24-element array via config['ebr_target_wh'] or station_state.ebr_target_wh_override
gap19_insertion_point.governance_action: REPLACE the rigid 6-hour static formula with Candidate D dynamic reserve trajectory in research harness

split_governance.training_period: 2020-2021 (731 origins) for AR(1) dynamics and scale fitting
split_governance.calibration_period: 2022 (365 origins) for conformal risk calibration q_cal(1-epsilon)
split_governance.blind_evaluation_period: 2025 Blind Dataset (364 origins) completely untouched; 2024 quarantined from primary evaluation

validation_design.simulation_protocol: 24-hour receding-horizon closed-loop simulation with hourly reoptimization and strict realization firewall
experimental_arms: Arm 0: Candidate F Point Baseline + Static 6h EBR
Arm 1: Static q10 Benchmark + Static 6h EBR
Arm 2: Candidate D Dynamic Risk Reserve (Proposed)

metrics.safety_reliability: Realized critical unmet load (Wh) and System Reliability (%)
metrics.economic_resource: Diesel fuel consumed (L), Renewable curtailment (Wh), Battery EFC
metrics.statistical_test: Paired Wilcoxon signed-rank test and 10,000-sample BCa bootstrap confidence intervals

blocked_items: Horizons k in [20..24] in historical solar dataset due to polar night termination
Ground telemetry context features (Class B) quarantined until ingestion latency is modeled
Closed-loop controller execution on production code
unresolved_risks: Synthetic wind benchmark: current wind errors are synthetic artifacts, requiring validation on real wind telemetry
Sub-Arctic winter extreme cold events causing diesel startup delays not modeled in linear MILP

recommended_first_experiment.objective: Evaluate closed-loop receding-horizon performance of Candidate D vs Arm 1 (static q10) and Arm 0 (baseline) across 364 origins of untouched 2025 data
recommended_first_experiment.parameter_freeze: Freeze phi=0.6386, clearsky scaling, and q_cal on 2020-2022 data prior to execution
recommended_first_experiment.primary_hypothesis: Candidate D matches Arm 1's critical reliability (>= 99.80%) while reducing diesel fuel by >= 15% and curtailment by >= 30%

decision_criteria.pass: Critical reliability >= 99.80%, 0 SOC floor violations (<20%), diesel fuel statistically lower than Arm 1 (p < 0.01, >= 10% reduction), and curtailment reduced >= 25%
decision_criteria.fail: Critical unmet load > 10% higher than Arm 1, OR any SOC floor violation (<20%), OR fuel reduction not statistically significant
decision_criteria.inconclusive: Fuel is reduced but critical unmet load falls in the ambiguous +0% to +10% band, or statistical significance is marginal (p >= 0.05)
